bpmn2:process.studyflow:documentation: Figure S1: a use-case pipeline harmonizing EEG, fMRI, and behavioral recordings. Three source datasets feed modality-specific preprocessing (fMRIPrep, EEGPrep, BDM conversion); a compose/expansion step produces a harmonized corpus, then a training chain.
bpmn2:process.name: Multimodal preprocessing and training
